# Site for sale

> Unique Opportunity - Partially Built Home on 5.04 Acres in Annaghdown, Just Outside Galway City Looking to build your dream home without the hassle of securing planning permission? This partially built house in Annaghdown presents a rare opportunity to create a forever home in a tranquil rural setting - without the restrictions of the local need planning requirement.

- Druh nabídky: sale
- Plocha: 318 m²
- Lokalita: Annaghdown, Eanach Dhin, Annaghdown
